content.value_statement: Website issues across SEO, speed, accessibility, security, and content are difficult to prioritize. Squirrelscan runs structured audits and returns a health score with actionable findings.
actual_capabilities: Runs local or cloud-backed website audits through the squirrel CLI.
Explains coverage modes for quick, surface, and full crawls.
Produces compact LLM-formatted audit reports for agent review.
Guides authentication, API-key setup, and cloud-credit checks.
Compares stored audits to identify regressions.
Configures crawler behavior and request headers for authorized sites.
limitations: Requires the squirrel CLI to be installed and available on PATH.
Audits only websites that the user is authorized to assess.
Cloud rendering, publishing, and scheduled features require an account and may use credits.
The skill identifies issues but does not automatically modify website code.

use_cases.title: Check a marketing site before launch
use_cases.description: Run a focused audit to find SEO, performance, accessibility, and content issues before release.

use_cases.title: Track regressions in continuous integration
use_cases.description: Compare stored audit results and fail a build when a site-health threshold is not met.

use_cases.title: Prioritize an accessibility improvement backlog
use_cases.description: Review audit findings in an LLM-friendly format and group fixes by severity and category.

prompt_templates.title: Run a first audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit https://example.com with squirrelscan and summarize the five most important issues.

prompt_templates.title: Choose crawl coverage
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain which squirrelscan coverage mode fits a 200-page documentation site, then run the audit in LLM format.

prompt_templates.title: Review regressions
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the latest squirrelscan audit with the baseline and list new high-severity regressions.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a CI quality gate
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me configure squirrelscan for an authorized CI audit that fails when the health score is below 90. Explain credit and publishing effects first.

output_examples.input: Audit https://example.com and summarize urgent problems.
output: Health score and crawl coverage summary.
Prioritized issues grouped by SEO, performance, security, and accessibility.
Recommended next actions with affected pages.

output_examples.input: Compare the current audit with the previous baseline.
output: Severity-ranked changes for the release team.
A concise recommendation on whether to investigate before deployment.

output_examples.input: Explain why my audit used cloud credits.
output: The cloud feature that consumed credits.
The configured credit cap and confirmation behavior.
Options to reduce cloud use or run offline.

best_practices: Audit only sites you own or are authorized to assess.
Use LLM format when an AI agent will interpret the report.
Review publishing and credit confirmations before enabling cloud features.
anti_patterns: Do not scan third-party sites without permission.
Do not commit API keys or custom request-header values.
Do not use full coverage by default when a smaller crawl answers the question.

faq.question: Does squirrelscan require an account?
faq.answer: Local audits do not require an account. Cloud features require authentication.

faq.question: Can I audit a site without publishing a report?
faq.answer: Yes. Use the no-publish option, or use offline mode for no cloud activity.

faq.question: What does LLM format provide?
faq.answer: It provides compact audit output intended for AI agents to read and summarize.

faq.question: Can squirrelscan spend cloud credits?
faq.answer: Cloud rendering and related features can use credits. Review confirmations and your configured cap.

faq.question: How should I use an API key?
faq.answer: Store the key in the SQUIRRELSCAN_API_KEY environment variable and keep it out of source control.

faq.question: Can the skill fix my website automatically?
faq.answer: No. It helps identify and prioritize issues. You must implement and verify the fixes.
